Backups live on the server that holds the site. Offsite copies are made by that same server.

Reading needs **Read only** and changes need **Manage**, unless an endpoint says otherwise. [How to read this page](/docs/integrations/api-reference/#how-to-read-a-group-page).

### `GET /api/backups`

Every backup on every server, newest first - deleted sites' and the panel's own included.

- **Level:** Read only
- **Input:** `?siteSlug=&deleted=true|false&type=&serverId=&limit=&offset=`
- **Returns:** `{items: Backup[] (+ siteTitle, siteDeleted, siteKind), total, deletedSites}`

### `GET /api/sites/:slug/backups`

Backups of one site, each with its offsite copies.

- **Level:** Read only
- **Returns:** `{items: Backup[]}`

### `POST /api/sites/:slug/backups`

Back this site up now.

- **Level:** Manage
- **Notes:** Job
- **Input:** `{note?}`

### `POST /api/backups/:id/restore`

Restore a backup over the live site.

- **Level:** Manage
- **Notes:** Job · Destructive
- **Input:** `{skipPreRestoreBackup?: false}`

### `GET /api/backups/:id/download`

Download the archive, or only its files or its database.

Binary stream - fetch it with curl rather than the console.

- **Level:** Manage. Holds the site's database and wp-config.php; a panel snapshot needs Full
- **Notes:** Not over MCP
- **Input:** `?part=files|database (left out: everything, as one .tar)`
- **Returns:** `tar stream; with part, files.tar.gz or a .sql.gz phpMyAdmin imports`

### `POST /api/backups/:id/offsite`

Copy this backup offsite now, or retry a copy that gave up.

- **Level:** Manage
- **Notes:** Job
- **Input:** `{destinationId?}`

### `POST /api/backups/:id/fetch`

Pull an offsite copy back onto the site's current server.

- **Level:** Manage
- **Notes:** Job
- **Input:** `{destinationId}`

### `DELETE /api/backups/:id`

Delete a backup and, unless told otherwise, its offsite copies.

- **Level:** Full. A backup is the safety net, so removing one is Full
- **Notes:** Destructive
- **Input:** `?keepOffsite=true|false (default false)`

### `GET /api/backups/ids`

The ids of every backup some filters match that a bulk delete could take, across all pages.

- **Level:** Read only
- **Input:** `?siteSlug=&deleted=true|false&type=&serverId= (as GET /api/backups)`
- **Returns:** `{items: [{id, siteSlug, siteDeleted, status, remoteCopies}], total} - newest first, at most 5000`

### `POST /api/backups/bulk-delete`

Delete several backups and their offsite copies, named by id.

- **Level:** Full. A backup is the safety net, so removing one is Full
- **Notes:** Job · Destructive
- **Input:** `{ids: [id, ...]} (at most 5000; GET /api/backups/ids turns filters into ids)`
- **Returns:** `{job, count}`

### `GET /api/backups/overview`

Offsite health: destinations, last success, 24h counters, failures.

- **Level:** Read only
